static_evidence.finding: The parent requires exact freeze/pre-review/commit bindings before the once-only started record. Its original 180-second monotonic deadline covers worker startup, protocol checks, data/model work, checker and finalization; work deadlines reserve the existing close allowance. Acceptance requires zero process exit, natural whole-job closure, no forced termination, known terminal envelope, protection checks and final deadline gates; a provisional summary alone is insufficient.
